comentarios: One bout of a natural song, duplicated. Bird not seen while singing but a Sittasomus was seen moving between trees from the general source area of the sound. Sound from this species confirmed subsequently with fieldwork. Specimens taken. Bird was singing ~12m off the ground in the upper midstory of a mature cloud forest.  Reported in: Cuervo, A. M. et al. 2008. Avifauna of the northern Cordillera Central of the Andes, Colombia. Ornitología Neotropical 19:495–515
